liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hog Calling Contest** (1 other source): The source identifies this track as a new addition to the band's repertoire [1]
- **Elbow** (1 other source): This song had not been performed by the group for 257 shows prior to this date [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hog Calling Contest**: rare: 9 archived performances [8]
- **Banter (Jacket)**: rare: 6 archived performances [8]
- **Elbow**: back after 162 archived shows (4230 days); rare: 3 archived performances [8]
- **Happy Birthday To You**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Banter (The Wave)**: rare: 6 archived performances [8]
- **Stressin'**: back after 104 archived shows (994 days); rare: 13 archived performances [8]
- **Gondii**: rare: 8 archived performances [8]
- **Chang'e**: rare: 9 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-09-08.birds** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 116 min [1]
- **kglw2024-09-08.bandcampbootlegger**: soundboard; 16 songs; 120 min [3]
- **kglw2024-09-08.ToraTapesMX**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 121 min [4]
- **kglw2024-09-08.mysteryjackofficial**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 120 min [2]

## Around the show

- Drummer Jay Weinberg joined the lineup to perform this specific song [2]
- Guest drummer Jay Weinberg sat in for this particular track [2]
- The band wished Jay Weinberg a happy birthday following the performance of this song [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-09-08.birds**: taped by Birds; transferred by Birds; source: XYH-6 Stereo Microphone Capsule > H6 Handy Recorder [1]
- **kglw2024-09-08.bandcampbootlegger**: taped by Sam Joseph; source: SBD [3]. Also: The audio was recorded by the band's official sound crew members [3]
- **kglw2024-09-08.ToraTapesMX**: taped by Tora Tapes, Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; transferred by Tora Tapes; source: MTX - SBD + FOB (Zoom F3 + CA-14) [4]. Also: The recording mixes the official soundboard feed with the uploader's own capture [4]
- **kglw2024-09-08.mysteryjackofficial**: taped by @mysteryjackofficial; transferred by @mysteryjackofficial; source: AUD- Nakamichi CM300 Microphones with CP1 cardioid capsules> Tascam DR40 Linear PCM Recorder @ 24bit/48kHz WAV- ORTF- Pole clamped to the steel bar behind the… [2]
